name: 江湖风云2
english_name: Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II
english_description: In-game titled "Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II: Liaoning Storm Rising," a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Its map directory structure nearly matches this project's "Tianya" (Ends of the Earth) family (tybxjh, xhcii, zxty, ffxymud), and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is identical in content (a formatting tool added stray spaces to this copy, but the core text matches word for word) — making it the sixth confirmed member of that family, a relationship no archive had previously recorded.
